title: 飛行旅行
description: 搭乘飛機時的常用對話

sentences.en: Excuse me, would it be possible to switch to an aisle seat, because I have a long flight ahead and I tend to get up frequently to stretch my legs?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，可以換到走道座位嗎？因為前面還有很長的飛行時間，我經常需要起來伸展腿部。

sentences.en: The flight attendant informed us that we would be experiencing moderate turbulence for the next thirty minutes and asked everyone to return to their seats immediately.
sentences.zh: 空服員通知我們接下來三十分鐘會遇到中度亂流，並要求所有人立即回到座位。

sentences.en: Could you please bring me a blanket and a pillow, as the cabin temperature seems unusually cold tonight and I am hoping to get some sleep on this overnight flight?
sentences.zh: 能否請你給我一條毯子和一個枕頭？因為今晚機艙溫度似乎異常寒冷，而我希望在這趟過夜航班上睡一會兒。

sentences.en: The captain has just announced that we are currently cruising at an altitude of thirty-five thousand feet and should arrive at our destination approximately twenty minutes ahead of schedule.
sentences.zh: 機長剛宣布我們目前在三萬五千英尺的高度巡航，預計比預定時間提早約二十分鐘到達目的地。

sentences.en: I was wondering whether the in-flight entertainment system at my seat is malfunctioning, because the screen has been frozen on the same image since we took off.
sentences.zh: 我想問一下我座位的機上娛樂系統是不是故障了，因為螢幕從起飛以來就一直停在同一個畫面。

sentences.en: The meal options for today's flight include a chicken rice dish served with steamed vegetables, or a vegetarian pasta with tomato basil sauce and a side salad.
sentences.zh: 今天航班的餐點選項包括搭配蒸蔬菜的雞肉飯，或是搭配番茄羅勒醬和配菜沙拉的素食義大利麵。

sentences.en: Since I pre-ordered a special dietary meal when I booked my ticket, I expected it to be served before the regular meals, but the crew seems unaware of my request.
sentences.zh: 因為我訂票時預訂了特殊飲食餐點，我以為會比一般餐早送來，但機組人員似乎不知道我的要求。

sentences.en: The passenger sitting next to me, who has been coughing throughout the entire flight, kindly offered to wear a mask after noticing my visible discomfort with the situation.
sentences.zh: 坐在我旁邊整趟飛行一直在咳嗽的乘客，在注意到我明顯的不適後，主動提出戴口罩。

sentences.en: We have begun our initial descent into Tokyo, and the local time is currently seven forty-five in the morning with clear skies and a temperature of fifteen degrees Celsius.
sentences.zh: 我們已開始降落東京，當地時間目前是早上七點四十五分，晴天，氣溫攝氏十五度。

sentences.en: The overhead reading light above my seat does not seem to be working, which is quite inconvenient because I was planning to read during the four-hour flight.
sentences.zh: 我座位上方的閱讀燈好像不亮了，這相當不方便，因為我打算在這四小時的航程中看書。

sentences.en: I apologize for the inconvenience, but could you ask the passenger behind me to stop kicking my seat, as it has been happening repeatedly for the past hour?
sentences.zh: 很抱歉造成不便，但能否請你請後面的乘客停止踢我的椅背？這種情況在過去一小時裡一直反覆發生。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi service on this aircraft, which costs twelve dollars for the entire flight duration, allows passengers to browse the internet and send messages but does not support video streaming.
sentences.zh: 這架飛機的Wi-Fi服務全程收費十二美元，允許乘客瀏覽網頁和發送訊息，但不支援影片串流。

sentences.en: Due to strong headwinds encountered during the flight, the captain has informed us that our arrival will be delayed by approximately forty-five minutes from the originally scheduled time.
sentences.zh: 由於飛行途中遇到強勁逆風，機長通知我們抵達時間將比原定時間延遲約四十五分鐘。

sentences.en: The flight attendant demonstrated the safety procedures, including how to fasten your seatbelt, locate the emergency exits, and use the oxygen masks in case of cabin depressurization.
sentences.zh: 空服員示範了安全程序，包括如何繫安全帶、找到緊急出口，以及在機艙失壓時如何使用氧氣面罩。

sentences.en: I would like to purchase a pair of noise-canceling headphones from the in-flight catalog, which I noticed earlier has a selection of electronics and travel accessories.
sentences.zh: 我想從機上目錄購買一副降噪耳機，我之前注意到上面有電子產品和旅行配件的選擇。

sentences.en: The child in the row ahead of us has been crying for nearly an hour, and while I sympathize with the parents, I am finding it increasingly difficult to rest.
sentences.zh: 前排的小孩已經哭了將近一小時，雖然我同情父母，但我發現越來越難休息了。

sentences.en: As we prepare for landing, please make sure your tray table is stowed, your seat is in the upright position, and all personal belongings are secured beneath the seat in front of you.
sentences.zh: 在我們準備降落時，請確保您的餐桌已收起、座椅恢復直立位置，所有個人物品都放在前方座位下方。

sentences.en: The business class cabin, which features lie-flat seats and a personal entertainment screen, also provides passengers with amenity kits containing skincare products and sleep aids.
sentences.zh: 商務艙配備可平躺座椅和個人娛樂螢幕，還為旅客提供含有護膚品和助眠用品的盥洗包。

sentences.en: I accidentally left my passport in the seat pocket when I disembarked, but fortunately a flight attendant found it and returned it to me at the gate before I cleared immigration.
sentences.zh: 我下機時不小心把護照留在座椅口袋裡，但幸好一位空服員找到了，在我通過入境檢查前在登機門歸還給我。

sentences.en: The connecting flight that I was supposed to catch in Frankfurt has already departed by the time we land, so the airline will need to rebook me on the next available service.
sentences.zh: 我原本要在法蘭克福轉乘的航班在我們降落時已經起飛了，所以航空公司需要幫我改訂下一班可用的航班。

sentences.en: Would you mind lowering the window shade, since the sunlight streaming in is creating a strong glare on my screen that makes it impossible to watch the movie I selected?
sentences.zh: 你介意把遮陽板拉下來嗎？因為照射進來的陽光在我的螢幕上造成強烈反光，讓我無法觀看選好的電影。

sentences.en: The turbulence we experienced during the last hour, which the pilot described as unexpected clear-air turbulence, was the worst I have ever encountered in my twenty years of flying.
sentences.zh: 我們過去一小時經歷的亂流——機師稱之為意外的晴空亂流——是我二十年飛行經驗中遇過最嚴重的。

sentences.en: I specifically requested a bassinet seat when I made the reservation because I am traveling with my six-month-old infant, but I notice the seat assigned to me is a regular one.
sentences.zh: 我訂位時特別要求了嬰兒搖籃座位，因為我帶著六個月大的嬰兒旅行，但我注意到分配給我的是一般座位。

sentences.en: The duty-free cart that just passed through the aisle had a wide selection of perfumes, chocolates, and liquor at prices significantly lower than what you would find in regular retail stores.
sentences.zh: 剛經過走道的免稅推車有各種香水、巧克力和酒類，價格比一般零售店便宜很多。

sentences.en: After the seatbelt sign was turned off following our ascent to cruising altitude, several passengers immediately stood up to retrieve items from the overhead compartments.
sentences.zh: 爬升到巡航高度後安全帶燈號關閉，數位乘客立即站起來從頭頂置物櫃取東西。

sentences.en: The airline's mobile app sent me a notification indicating that my checked luggage has been successfully loaded onto the aircraft, which gives me peace of mind about my belongings.
sentences.zh: 航空公司的手機應用程式發了通知給我，表示我的託運行李已成功裝上飛機，讓我對自己的物品安心了。

sentences.en: I am feeling quite nauseous due to the constant turbulence, so could you please bring me an airsickness bag and perhaps a glass of water with some ice?
sentences.zh: 由於持續的亂流我感覺很想吐，能否請你給我一個嘔吐袋和一杯加冰的水？

sentences.en: The emergency exit row offers significantly more legroom compared to standard economy seats, but passengers sitting there must be willing and able to assist during an evacuation.
sentences.zh: 緊急出口排比標準經濟艙座位有明顯多的腿部空間，但坐在那裡的乘客必須願意且能夠在疏散時協助。

sentences.en: The pilot announced that we would be circling the airport for approximately twenty minutes because the runway is temporarily closed due to a minor incident on the ground.
sentences.zh: 機師宣布我們將在機場上空盤旋約二十分鐘，因為跑道由於地面的一個小事故暫時關閉。

sentences.en: Once we reach the gate, passengers with tight connections are kindly asked to remain seated while those needing to catch connecting flights within thirty minutes are allowed to deplane first.
sentences.zh: 到達登機門後，請轉機時間充裕的旅客留在座位上，讓需要在三十分鐘內趕轉機航班的旅客先行下機。
